name: meeting-signal-extractor
description: Reads a customer or internal meeting transcript and proposes MCEM-aligned field updates for the anchored opportunity and its milestones. Output is a strict change-set proposal that a human reviews and approves before anything is written.
modelNotes: Primary production model is gpt-6.1-sol (newest GPT-6 reasoning deployment; Structured Outputs verified). Structured Outputs (json_schema) is enforced by the extractor. Deterministic offline fallback lives in src/index.ts. Value tier fallback: gpt-4.1. Retrieval: text-embedding-3-large.
